title: ZFS: The Last Word in File Systems Part 1
summary: Jeff Bonwick and Bill Moore, the creators of ZFS, present 'ZFS: The Last Word in File Systems' at the 2008 SNIA Software Developers' Conference. They explain the design, including copy-on-write, checksumming and avoiding the write hole.
why: HN recommends it as the definitive explanation of ZFS design straight from its inventors, with war stories about data integrity.

quote.text: I would recommend anybody interested in filesystems to watch Jeff Bonwick (ZFS inventor) explain the design of ZFS
